tasks.label: Minimize2Tray: create/push version tag (automatically publishes)
args:
set -euo pipefail
fail() { printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
workflow=.github/workflows/release-packages.yml
test -s "$workflow" || fail 'Required workflow missing: .github/workflows/release-packages.yml.'
git ls-files --error-unmatch "$workflow" >/dev/null || fail 'The enabled workflow must be committed first.'
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main || fail 'Run this task on main.'
pending=$(git status --porcelain)
test -z "$pending" || fail 'Commit or set aside pending changes first.'
fetch_url=$(git remote get-url origin)
push_url=$(git remote get-url --push --all origin)
for url in "$fetch_url" "$push_url"; do
  case "$url" in
    https://github.com/PhobosK/kwin-minimize2tray|https://github.com/PhobosK/kwin-minimize2tray.git|git@github.com:PhobosK/kwin-minimize2tray|git@github.com:PhobosK/kwin-minimize2tray.git|ssh://git@github.com/PhobosK/kwin-minimize2tray|ssh://git@github.com/PhobosK/kwin-minimize2tray.git) ;;
    *) fail 'origin must fetch and push only PhobosK/kwin-minimize2tray on github.com.' ;;
  esac
done
remote_main=$(git ls-remote --exit-code origin refs/heads/main) || fail 'Could not read remote main; nothing was tagged.'
read -r remote_sha remote_ref <<< "$remote_main"
[[ "$remote_ref" == refs/heads/main && "$remote_sha" == "$(git rev-parse --verify 'HEAD^{commit}')" ]] || fail 'Local main must match remote main; nothing was tagged.'
version=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("package/metadata.json"))["KPlugin"]["Version"])')
core='(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)'
[[ "$version" =~ ^$core$ ]] || fail 'Invalid version in metadata.json.'
grep -Fqx "%{!?release_version:%global release_version $version}" distro/rpm/kwin6-script-minimize2tray.spec || fail 'RPM spec version mismatch.'
header=$(head -n 1 distro/debian/changelog)
[[ "$header" == "kwin6-script-minimize2tray ($version-"* ]] || fail 'Current Debian changelog version mismatch.'
deb_header='^kwin6-script-minimize2tray \([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-[1-9][0-9]*\) '
[[ "$header" =~ $deb_header ]] || fail 'Invalid Debian revision.'
state=$(gh api repos/PhobosK/kwin-minimize2tray/actions/workflows/release-packages.yml --jq .state)
[[ "$state" == active ]] || fail 'The remote release workflow must be enabled on main first.'
tag=v$version
if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/tags/$tag"; then fail "Local tag $tag already exists."; else status=$?; [[ "$status" -eq 1 ]] || fail 'Could not inspect local tags.'; fi
if git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin "refs/tags/$tag"; then fail "Remote tag $tag already exists."; else status=$?; [[ "$status" -eq 2 ]] || fail 'Could not read remote tags; nothing was tagged.'; fi
git tag -a "$tag" -m "Release $tag"
git push --no-follow-tags origin "refs/tags/$tag:refs/tags/$tag" || fail "Push failed. Local tag $tag was kept; inspect it before retrying."
printf 'Pushed %s; GitHub Actions will build and publish its packages.\n' "$tag"
tasks.detail: Creates and pushes only a new version tag after checking clean main, the fork remote, remote main, matching package versions and the enabled workflow. The push publishes a release.
